**There is evidence of tree-cover loss in an area mapped as native forest, but it is not yet corroborated.**

In 2025, satellite data identified about 13.5 hectares of tree-cover loss on the property, or 3.9% of its area. Uruguay’s 2021 forest map classified 13.1 hectares of the affected area as native forest.

Because 2025 is the latest year observed, a later year is needed to corroborate whether the change persists. The evidence does not establish whether deforestation or land-use change occurred, or what caused the loss.
